I got one from sunbox, but you want one with at least 10k lux. White light seems more tested and "safer" than blue(though its unknown). Use it for 20 minutes in the early morning every day and look at the light indirectly. You can also use it when you feel tired midday though make sure not to use at in the evening/night.

I used to be really, really miserable in cloudy winter days but now I just feel neutral I guess.

Also the free f.lux program https://justgetflux.com/ helps by filtering out the blue light in your computer screen at night. Both the lightbox and F.lux work by the circadian rhythm, how your body keeps time. Bright(blue) light during the day and darkness at night(or at least eliminating blue light) help a lot. Think its to do with melatonin and maybe serotonin.
Seasonal Depression, or Sleep issues? A lightbox worked for me. F.lux too
